map.这是一段需要换行处理的文本，用来演示换行功能。你可以设置每行的字符数，工具会自动: This is a paragraph that needs wrapping, used to demo the wrap feature. You can set the number of characters per line; the tool inserts line breaks at sensible positions so long text becomes multiple lines.
map.字符模式：行数 = ⌈文本长度 / 宽度⌉，第 i 行 = 文本[i×宽度 :: Character mode: lines = ⌈text length / width⌉, line i = text[i×width : (i+1)×width]; word mode: split by whitespace, wrap when cumulative length exceeds width; over-long words (word length > width) are force-split by width
map.字符模式严格按定长切分，会切断英文单词与中文词语，适合固定宽度设备（如小票、终端: Character mode strictly cuts at fixed length and can break English words and Chinese words, suiting fixed-width devices (e.g. receipts, terminals). Word mode keeps words whole; it yields slightly more lines but reads better and is the default for body text. Both modes count by UTF-16 code units, so with emoji or surrogate-pair characters (like 𝕏 or some emojis) the count runs high; visual width follows actual rendering. Line break can be \n, \r\n or

map.会在词中断开吗？: Will it break inside a word?
map.默认在空格处断行（不切断英文词）；中文无空格时可按字符宽断，需开启「按字符」模式: By default it breaks at spaces (never cutting English words); Chinese has no spaces, so it can break by character width — turn on "by character" mode to avoid overflow.
map.分割按分隔符拆，换行按宽度智能折行并保持语义完整，适合排版而非数据拆分。: Splitting breaks text by a delimiter; line wrapping intelligently folds by width while keeping meaning intact — better for layout than for data splitting.
